item.title: Safeguarding cryptocurrency by disclosing quantum vulnerabilities responsibly
item.description:
📝 In a new whitepaper, we show that future quantum computers may break the elliptic curve cryptography that protects cryptocurrency and other systems with fewer qubits and gates than previously realized. Quantum resource estimates Quantum computers promise to solve otherwise impossible problems, including examples in chemistry, drug discovery, and energy. Specifically, we have compiled two quantum circuits (a sequence of quantum gates) that implement Shor's algorithm for ECDLP-256: one that uses less than 1,200 logical qubits and 90 million Toffoli gates and one that uses less than 1,450 logical qubits and 70 million Toffoli gates.
🔗 Read more: https://research.google/blog/safeguarding-cryptocurrency-by-disclosing-quantum-vulnerabilities-responsibly/
